purpose: Pre-registered checkpoint selection for results/residual_6d_rand_fixa001_2cm_s42_20k (written before training starts; copied into each run directory at launch)
candidates: checkpoints/ckpt_00002000.pt ... ckpt_00020000.pt, every 1000 env steps (ckpt_00001000 excluded: end of zero-residual warmup, no SAC update yet)
seed_note: episode i uses reset/noise seed 1000+i; the 50-episode test evaluation uses seeds 0-49. LIBERO initial states come from the task's fixed list (validation reuses init states 0-9 with different noise seeds).
score: total successes over the 40 validation episodes
selection: highest score; ties broken in favour of the later checkpoint

reported_policies.final: ckpt_00020000.pt (primary answer to whether fixing the entropy coefficient prevents late collapse)
reported_policies.selected: validation-selected checkpoint (result of the pre-registered protocol)

test_evaluation: both policies on the 9 standard conditions (0cm, +-x/+-y at 2cm and 4cm), 50 episodes each, eval seed 0, paired with the frozen base
